title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: SYNOPSIS: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil), the official organization representing sports physical therapists in Brazil, developed this clinical practice guideline to support clinicians and athletes in managing hamstring strain injury. The GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation) approach was used to address the clinical question "Which interventions provided by physical therapists improve rehabilitation outcomes in athletes with hamstring strain injury?" The guideline provides an updated and targeted synthesis of evidence from randomized clinical trials, offering practical guidance to inform clinical decision making by physical therapists across diverse health care and sports settings. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 2026;56(10):627-641. Epub 28 August 2026. doi:10.2519/jospt.2026.14372.
